apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Google Play URLs (play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.duolingo), package names (com.duolingo) or app names (Duolingo). Names resolve to the best match of Google Play search.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter Play Store country codes, e.g. us, gb, de, fr, in, br. Reviews are per storefront, so add several to cover more.

language.title: Language
language.description: Review language code (en, de, fr, es, pt, ja, ...).

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Newest first, most relevant (Google's ranking) or by rating.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews per app and country
maxReviews.description: You are charged per review delivered.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Keep only reviews with at least this many stars (1-5).

maxRating.title: Maximum rating
maxRating.description: Keep only reviews with at most this many stars. Use 1-2 to find complaints.

since.title: Since
since.description: Only reviews on or after this date, e.g. 2026-01-31. With newest-first sorting the scan stops as soon as older reviews appear.
